title: アカデミックライティング
subtitle: Academic Writing
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn how to write technical reports. (2) Acquire skills to investigate technical information in the ICT field. (3) Set the subjects and acquire skills to write their claims as technical reports.
advice: This is an academic writing course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Problem discovery 2. Collecting information 3. Configuration of subject matters 4. Report outlines 5. Draft technical reports 6. Technical reports Students are expected to bring their notebook PC and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This course will need the following knowledge/skills: 1. The units of “Basic Style for Study A” and “Basic Style for Study B” have been acquired. 2. Basic report writing skills.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
